answer: The crystal schedule is applied in sparrow and raven reveals each instalment. A payout is split and thus 50% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4466 identities would post 2423 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
